from base_sensor import BaseVirtualSensor

class BMP280_Simulator(BaseVirtualSensor):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.regs = {
            0xD0: 0x58,  # chip_id
            0xE0: 0x00,  # reset
            0xF3: 0x00,  # status
            0xF4: 0x00,  # ctrl_meas
            0xF5: 0x00,  # config
            0xF7: 0x80,  # press_msb
            0xF8: 0x00,  # press_lsb
            0xF9: 0x00,  # press_xlsb
            0xFA: 0x80,  # temp_msb
            0xFB: 0x00,  # temp_lsb
            0xFC: 0x00,  # temp_xlsb
        }

    def read_register(self, addr: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> int:
        if addr in self.regs:
            value = self.regs[addr]
            if nbytes == 1:
                return (value >> 8) & 0xFF
            return value
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid register address: {addr}")

    def write_register(self, addr: int, data: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> None:
        if addr in self.regs:
            if addr == 0xE0:  # reset register
                if data == 0xB6:
                    self._reset()
                return
            if addr == 0xF3 or addr == 0xF7 or addr == 0xF8 or addr == 0xF9 or addr == 0xFA or addr == 0xFB or addr == 0xFC:
                # RO registers, ignore writes
                return
            if nbytes == 1:
                mask = 0xFF << 8
                data <<= 8
            else:
                mask = 0xFFFF
            current_value = self.regs[addr]
            new_value = (current_value & ~mask) | (data & mask)
            self.regs[addr] = new_value
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid register address: {addr}")

    def _reset(self) -> None:
        for addr, reset_value in {
            0xE0: 0x00,  # reset
            0xF3: 0x00,  # status
            0xF4: 0x00,  # ctrl_meas
            0xF5: 0x00,  # config
            0xF7: 0x80,  # press_msb
            0xF8: 0x00,  # press_lsb
            0xF9: 0x00,  # press_xlsb
            0xFA: 0x80,  # temp_msb
            0xFB: 0x00,  # temp_lsb
            0xFC: 0x00,  # temp_xlsb
        }.items():
            self.regs[addr] = reset_value
